text_block_list.text:
Our 'first three years' with Gold Ship are 
finally reaching their climax—

The end-of-year Arima Kinen had arrived 
once again.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Life isn't a straight line like a 
racecourse is.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There are mountains, there are valleys, 
there are rivers, and eventually they lead 
to the sea.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There will be times when gravity reverses, 
and you might get blown off into outer 
space.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't you worry, though. Someday it'll 
surely return to the ocean... Water's 
always circulating, after all!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"No, that makes zero sense... What are you 
even talking about?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Could this be... her own unique way of 
psyching herself up?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo, I'm blown away. Didn't expect you two 
to be here.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"If you compared today's race to terrain, 
it'd probably be a massive mountain—no, a 
whole mountain range like the Japanese 
Alps."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'll conquer those mountains. I'll 
blow past all of you and break out into 
the open sea...!!”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We have clashed many times, sharpening 
each other's skills along the way.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I will give it my all today to demonstrate 
the results of my training.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, I'm totally different 
from how I used to be.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Today, I am seriously, completely, 100% 
for real!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! I felt your feelings, burning 
hot as magma!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
With heat that won't lose to anyone, I'll 
turn this track into a sea of lavaaa!!

The final race of the Twinkle Series is 
finally about to begin—!
